rationale: FX01 flags missing principal_amount_usd. The raw schedule of investments supplies debt par amounts for the flagged quarter, including Saturn Sound Bidco Limited with Par ($) / Shares of 60,289 while the artifact value is blank. The schedule also includes a Flexera Software LLC first lien term loan tied to EURIBOR with par 10,601 and USD cost/fair value of 12,386/12,419, showing that explicit USD principal normalization is material for at least one non-USD debt row. The missing normalized principal field is therefore a real extraction/normalization gap, not a false alarm.
